newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold price and traded volume rise.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold price and traded volume rise.

text.p: Traded volume on the Istanbul gold exchange firmed to 1,194 kilos on Monday, after diving to 680 kilos on Friday, due to fresh demand at the beginning of the week, brokers said.
Gold closed higher at $328 an ounce and 1,675,400 lira per gram, compared to $326.00 an ounce and 1,663,500 lira closes on Friday.
"Seasonal demand for gold fuels prices in the free market. Banks are selling gold at higher prices to the free market," said a trader.
The lira closed weaker at 159,210 per dollar from 158,050 Friday, depending on the dollar's strength in the international markets.
Most of the day's trade -- 1,173 kilos-- took place in the morning session, with 65.6 percent conducted in lira terms. -- Istanbul newsroom +90-212-275 08 75
